Then back to her neck, the tag darker (ref 0:18). CAPTIONS: white text in boxes + big blue DAY titles exactly like the reference.
OFFER: on screen only at the end, like the reference's "Click shop now": early Black Friday Buy 1 Get 1. Landing page: Skin Tags page.
CLAIMS: same wording as our launched #156/#78 ("dries out and falls off"), but it's a removal claim. Softer back-up line if Meta rejects it: "by day four it had shrunk to almost nothing".
Doc: Brief H+S, tab "#47".

Voiceover: Female, 30s-40s, casual and excited, like she's showing her friend (match the reference's quick, chatty pace, about 33 s). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: ONE woman, and a DIFFERENT person from anyone in the reference (new face, new hair, new setting): a real-looking woman 45 to 55, shoulder-length brown hair she pulls back to show her neck, filming herself on her phone in her own bathroom and bedroom (natural light). ONE small, realistic skin tag on the SIDE OF HER NECK, the same tag in every shot (consistent spot and size), slowly getting darker and smaller day by day. Real skin texture, no gore. Big honest reactions like the reference's (ref 0:20 the wide-eyed "Day 4" face).
